supersedes: none — evaluated alongside the original G1–G7 in final_campaign_config.json (sha256 f03616e139c0a0ecc48db7a70bd82d6693aa513c4b8e83270d641dc6dcac06f9), which stay unchanged
client_rule: a client is predicted bot if any scored decision for that client is flagged; a manifest client with no scored decision counts as not flagged (bot = miss, human = negative)
scorable_rule: a client is scorable if its telemetry shows non-static session depth > 20 and session duration >= 3.0 s at some request

R1_identity.description: every scored record carries the full identity tuple and it equals the pinned manifest; one tuple per model across the run

R2_coverage.description: share of scorable manifest clients with at least one scored decision

R3_timeouts_errors.description: count of records whose evaluationStatus is Timeout, SemaphoreFull, Error or Failed, or whose shadowStatus is timeout/error, or HTTP status >= 500

R4_timing_features.description: f6 and f7 are non-default on at least one scored record

R5_human_fpr.description: client-level human FPR; gate on the exact Clopper–Pearson one-sided upper bound

R6_bot_recall.description: per bot profile recall over ALL manifest clients of that profile (unscored = miss)

R7_gateway_overhead.description: p95 latency of async-ML gateway minus p95 of proxy-only gateway at the same concurrency, from the B2 benchmark; FAIL if no measurement is available
